Mile 1 · Gold Path · Diamond Apparel

Diamond Apparel — shop the gold path.

A clothing brand built on one standard: anyone can wear it, few can live it. Design-first streetwear for anyone who likes the design — men, women, and kids, with name & number customization front and center. These five are live in the Garland Enterprises catalog; the Instagram shop is built and in Meta's review — product tagging unlocks when Meta approves it. Mile 2 · Ice-Blue Path · Elite Diamond

Hockey parents: this is your path.

Hockey training on Long Island, in collaboration with Precip Hockey Sticks. Train hard. Play smart. Shine bright. Elite Diamond is in build & relaunch — and you don't need the apparel shop, and you'll never be sent there. Elite signups live on Elite's own storefront — the ice-blue path, start to finish.

1

Pick the level

Beginner Training, Intermediate Coaching, or Advanced Skills — the collections on Elite's storefront walk you to the right fit for your player.

2

Add to cart

Choose the coaching product and add it to cart on the Elite Diamond Shopify store. Same simple checkout as any shop — no forms maze, no gimmicks.

3

Checkout — you're signed up

Checkout settles with Elite Diamond Hockey Academy itself. That's the right-company rule: parents pay Elite, apparel buyers pay Diamond, never crossed.

Coaching signups and the academy's writing live in the same place — so a parent who reads a guide is one tap from registering.

Mile 3 · Ember Path · Learn the Trade

Fire-alarm learning, taught straight.

This is Chris's own teaching path — inspections, testing, and troubleshooting on life-safety systems: honest work that actually matters, shared on his own terms. No employer branding, no company store, nothing to buy. Just the craft, done right.

What this path will teach

How fire-alarm systems workDevices & circuitsInspections, done rightTroubleshooting mindsetPride in the work

Lessons are in the works. Follow along on Garlandry to catch the first drop — new lessons will live here on the ember path. If you work with your hands, are thinking about the trade, or just want to understand the systems protecting the buildings around you, this path is yours.

About Chris Garland

I'm Chris Garland. I live on Long Island, I work with my hands, and I'm building something bigger than myself. By day I'm a Fire Alarm Technician — inspections, testing, and troubleshooting on life-safety systems — honest work that actually matters. By night I'm the founder of Garland Enterprises (est. February 2024), the umbrella for everything I'm creating.

I post my life as I explore it — the job sites, the ice, the gym, the builds. Fitness, hockey, MMA, jiu-jitsu, guitar. My channel isn't one genre; it's one person, getting better in public. James Madison University, B.A. Communications Studies, Class of 2024.

All they got, all the time.
